personality_one_liner: A highly readable, industrial-clean utility interface that prioritizes fast visual parsing for mechanics and service advisors on the shop floor.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, safe area clearance, thumb-friendly touch targets min 44pt.

do's: Bottom tab bar (when content scrolls behind)

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Email/password login with email OTP verification.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top (classic red sports car) taking 40% of the screen with a gradient scrim fading to background. Below, a clean white card for the login form. Email input, Password input, 'Send OTP' button. Once OTP is sent, cross-fade to OTP input. Bottom CTA 'Login'.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's KPI stats (jobs, revenue, pending invoices, low stock) for service advisors.

states.empty: Illustration of empty garage + 'No data for today'

screens.layout: Scrollable dashboard. Large bold title 'Overview'. Top section: 2-column grid of KPI cards (Jobs Today, Revenue, Pending Invoices, Low Stock) using surfaceSecondary, shadow 1, and brandTertiary tinted icons. Below: 'Recent Jobs' horizontal scroll or short list of 3 items. Bottom: 'AI Helper' banner with engine block background and gradient scrim, encouraging users to ask for recommendations.

screens.name: Jobs
screens.purpose: List and create Job Cards/Work Orders linked to customers and vehicles.

states.empty: Empty clipboard icon + 'No active jobs' + CTA 'Create Job'

screens.layout: Header with 'Jobs' and '+' icon (or FAB). Segmented control (sticky, glass) for 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Completed'. Scrollable list of Job Cards. Each Job Card uses iOS-Native Clean layout: md padding, Vehicle Model & ID at top left, Status Badge (color-coded success/warning) at top right, Customer Name and brief scope below. Actionable footer inside the card with a secondary CTA ('Update Status'). Large touch targets.

screens.name: Customers
screens.purpose: Directory of customers and their linked vehicles.
screens.layout: Search bar at the top (sticky). Alphabetical list of customers. Each row uses a tinted initials avatar (brandTertiary) if no photo. Shows Customer Name, Phone, and number of linked vehicles. Tap to view Customer Detail screen showing their full Vehicle Registry.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Manage spare parts and track low-stock items.
screens.layout: Search bar + Filter (sticky). List of parts. Rows show Part Name, SKU, and Current Stock. If stock is low, a 'warning' colored badge or text appears. Tapping opens a bottom sheet to edit quantity.

screens.name: AI Helper
screens.purpose: AI service recommendation helper with chat-like input.

states.empty: AI Engine icon + 'Describe the issue to get recommendations'

screens.layout: Chat interface. Bottom input area inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Bubbles for user query and AI response. AI responses use markdown styling with clear lists for recommended parts and labor hours.

login_hero.alt: Classic red sports car front view in studio

ai_helper_banner.alt: Detailed close up of a modern metallic car engine

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. Use PlusJakartaSans font family and generous spacing.
Implement the 'Jobs' tab with card-based list views. Ensure each card has a clear status badge (Open/In Progress/Completed) utilizing the defined success/warning/info status colors.
BANNED colors: Indigo, violet, purple, blue, navy, orange, terracotta are strictly avoided. The brand uses a mechanical Deep Burgundy (#BE123C).
Use Phosphor icons consistently (one weight/style per screen, except the tab bar which can be outlined-inactive / filled-active).
For the login hero image, MUST apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient vertical fade to surfaceInverse) so text overlaid is readable.
Use sticky primary CTA buttons at the bottom of the screen (above safe area) where applicable (e.g., 'Login', 'Create Job', 'Send OTP').
Apply glassmorphism (expo-glass-effect / expo-blur) to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers where content scrolls behind them.
All tap targets must be minimum 44x44pt. Use hitSlop for smaller visual icons.
Include bottom sheet using @gorhom/bottom-sheet for quick edits like Inventory quantity updates.
Serialize subtle haptics on feature actions (primary buttons, tab items, segmented controls).
